inputs.content: Finite-dimensional linear algebra, polar coordinates, Haar integration on Lie groups, Tonelli/Fubini and dominated differentiation, local smooth retractions of embedded submanifolds, Hilbert orthogonal projections and strong continuity of unitary translations. The reproduction formula and its Fubini majorant are proved in the component.
